statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I47.1 was used
The diagnosis code I25.10 was used
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to assess for underlying ischemic triggers during daily activities
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
